        transom_size (tuple): Dimensions of transoms (width, depth) in meters.
        glazing_inset (float): Inset distance for glazing panels from facade datum in meters.
        spandrel_depth (float): Depth of shadow-box spandrels in meters.
        fin_size (tuple): Dimensions of vertical fins (width, depth) in meters.
        fin_spacing (int): Number of bays between fins.
        fin_offset (float): Offset distance of fins from mullion centerline in meters.
        panel_max_width (float): Maximum width of glazing panels in meters.

        sill_transom_box = rg.Box(rg.Plane.WorldXY, rg.Interval(x_position, x_position + transom_size[0]),

        head_transom_box = rg.Box(rg.Plane.WorldXY, rg.Interval(x_position, x_position + transom_size[0]),

                                              rg.Point3d(x_end, 0, head_transom),
                                              rg.Point3d(x_start, 0, head_transom),
                                              rg.Point3d(x_start, 0, sill_transom)], 1),
            rg.Line(rg.Point3d(0, 0, 0), rg.Point3d(0, spandrel_depth, 0))
        )
        facade_elements.append(glazing_surface.ToBrep())

    # Create vertical fins
    for i in range(num_sections // fin_spacing + 1):
        x_position = i * bay_width * fin_spacing
        fin = rg.Box(rg.Plane.WorldXY, rg.Interval(x_position + fin_offset, x_position + fin_offset + fin_size[0]),
